messages:
Aisha: Hey team — kicking off cloud marketplace listing work for AWS/GCP/Azure. Need owners, immediate blockers, and legal assets. Goal: get a minimal GA-ready listing for each cloud (AMI/container/VM offer) and a clear SKU mapping by end of week.
Tom: I can own build artifacts (AMI + container images). Need CI publisher creds and a naming convention for SKUs. @Sam can you enable CI access to the publisher portals?
Sam: Yep — I'll provision an IAM role and add ci@redwood as a principal (role name pub-ci). ETA today. For SKUs let's use: REDWOOD-<CLOUD>-<OFFER>-v<MAJOR>. Example: REDWOOD-AWS-INFERENCE-v1.
Lina: Legal asks: provide MSA + localized EULA (EN, FR, DE) and a list of any third-party logos/licensees included in the bundle. Also need a short privacy blurb for the listing (EU DPA considerations).
Jorge: Heads-up — telemetry on trial instances must be opt-in and scrub PII. We'll expose an opt-in toggle in the onboarding flow and a telemetry endpoint that strips user identifiers. Product flags will gate trial-only features per cloud.
Aisha: Good notes. Minimal manifest example for packaging and SKU metadata (use this across portals):

```json
{
  "offer_name": "redwood-inference",
  "sku": "REDWOOD-AWS-INFERENCE-v1",
  "cloud": "aws",
  "artifacts": {
    "ami": "ami-0abc12345example",
    "container": "gcr.io/redwood/inference:stable"
  },
  "trial": {
    "days": 14,
    "telemetry_opt_in_required": true
  },
  "legal": {
    "eula": "s3://redwood-assets/eula/en_v1.pdf",
    "privacy": "s3://redwood-assets/privacy/en_v1.md"
  }
}
```

Tom: For GCP we also need a package.yaml and listing contact. I'll author the package.yaml and include licensing info. Any restrictions on exported models or weights we should call out?
Lina: If we include any non-open checkpoints, we need clear licensing and redistribution clauses. If everything is our code/config + open checkpoints with proper attribution, standard listing is fine.
Sam: CI/ops notes: build matrix will target linux/amd64 and arm64 for container images; AMI will be x86_64 for initial GA. Azure requires a VHD and plan metadata — I'll add that to the pipeline. Also need publisher access (Sam) and publisher portal invites for Tom and Aisha.
Aisha: Owners: Tom = artifacts, Sam = publisher access + CI pipeline, Lina = legal assets, Jorge = telemetry/privacy. I'll spin up a shared spreadsheet with columns: cloud, sku, artifact_location, legal_assets_link, publisher_owner, status. Adding a column for "required screenshots / marketing blurbs" so marketing can pick up.
deploy-bot: Publisher invite sent to tom@redwood.com for AWS Seller Central (check spam).
Tom: Perfect — I'll start AMI bake tomorrow and push initial container images. Will ping when publisher account is ready. :thumbsup:
